title: RootSink: Reproducible C/C++ Crashes with Tested Candidate Root-Cause Sites
description: RootSink 1.0.5 holds 3,341 reproducible C/C++ crash records from OSS-Fuzz (via ARVO) and syzbot. Each record is an ordered list of CWE instances (for example CWE-20 -> CWE-787), each with a role, a site and its own evidence category, so the evidence for the sink and for the candidate root cause is stated per record. The 1,946 Reproduced-tier records were replayed at both revisions: the vulnerable build crashes at a sanitizer-reported sink, and the fixed build runs the same input cleanly. Where a record says so, the candidate root cause was tested by applying a single hunk of the developer's fix on its own. The archive holds the records, reproduction and sanitizer logs, single-hunk intervention results, a replay scorer for candidate patches, the inter-rater audit and the preregistered labelling rules. Docker images are referenced by digest and are not included. Data are CC BY 4.0; code is MIT.
